tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// gdong bzhi ba'i bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// bstan pa bsrung ba'i las brtson pa// nag po chen por bstod par bgyi// bstan pa spel zhing bsrung ba'i phyir// rdo rje 'chang bas byin brlabs nas// nyid kyi bka' yis gnyer bsgos pa// nag po chen po khyod la bstod// gnas rnams kun la rnam rol yang*// nges pa bzhin du gru 'dzin dang*// siṅga li dang ti se ru// rnam par gnas pa khyod la bstod// khyod ni gang du 'khod gyur pa// dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas te// de dbus pad+ma nyi ma la// bsgyings te bzhugs pa khyod la bstod// zhal bzhi pa dang phyag bzhi pa// zhabs gnyis gar gyi stabs kyis bzhugs// sku mdog nag po 'bar chen po// lhun po ltar brjid khyod la bstod// rtsa zhal nag po gdangs pa'i zhal// g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhing 'dzum// g.yon pa dmar zhing rgya cher bzhad// steng zhal dud kha khro gnyer gdong*// zhal re'ang dmar la zlum pa dang*// glog ltar 'khyug pa'i spyan gsum ldan// skra dang sma ra ser zhing 'bar// mche ba gtsigs pa khyod la bstod// phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug dang*// g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin// g.yas gnyis ral gri cig shos kyis// chang gi bum pa 'dzin la bstod// dung chen po dang lto 'gro dang*// stag dang dar gyi lhab lhub dang*// khrag dang zhag gi thig le yi// rgyan gyis sgeg pa khyod la bstod// mi mgo skam po'i cod pan dang*// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can// sbrul dang rgyu ma rlon pa yi// tshangs skud 'chang ba khyod la bstod// nyi ma'i 'od ltar cher gsal zhing*// dus mtha'i me ltar rab gdung ba'i// me lce'i phreng bas gdug pa kun// rnam par sreg pa khyod la bstod// ha ha'i gad mo rgya cher bzhad// hūm̐ hūm̐ 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs// k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ rnam par bsgyings pa'i sgras// sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la bstod// khyod thugs rdo rje 'dzin pa la// shin tu dad pas nyer zhi yang*// de yi bstan la gnod byed la// khro zhing 'khrugs pa khyod la bstod// nye bar zhi la nyer gzhol yang*// dam tshig sdom pas nyer mdzes shing*// bsgrub la brtson pa'i sgrub po la// rjes su chags pa khyod la bstod// 'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad dang*// ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la// bdag nyid dgyes dgur rnam rol cing*// 'phags pa mchod mdzad khyod la bstod// khyod dang rjes mtshungs dpa' mo ni// dpal gyis khyod la nyer mchod cing*// mthun par bstan pa rjes bsrungs pas// bskor ba khyod la bdag bstod do// g.yas na g.yung mo nag mo dang*// de bzhin g.yon na gtum mo ljang*// mdun na srin mo nag mo dang*// rgyab na siṅga lī gnas sngo// thams cad mdzes shing grims pa'i lus// sna tshogs rgyan gyis rab sgeg cing*// khro zhing 'dzum la stegs chos can// rngam zhing rgod la 'jigs rung ma// g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin pa yis// phyogs bcur gdug can rnam par bsdigs// g.yon pa khrag zhag gis gang ba'i// thod pa 'dzin pa'i lag pa yis// yab la 'khril zhing rnam par stobs// de bzhi zhal bzhi'i spyod yul te// dgyes pa'i tshe na sbyor ba yis// mgon po shin tu tshim byed cing*// las kyi tshe na mngon spyod kyis// dgra bgegs rnams la sgrol bar byed// lhun po gling bzhis bskor 'dra ba'i// yab yum rnams la gus pas bstod// khyod kyi bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs// kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan// mthu chen rdzu 'phrul chen po yi// shugs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par rgyug

/la la mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// kha cig snyim par dgra bo yi// khrag dang nang grol gyis bkang nas /za bzhin du ni rnam par rgyu// glog ltar myur zhing 'brug ltar sgrogs// rdo rje lta bur thogs med pas// khyod kyi bka' stsal sgrub byed pa// 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// de ltar yab dang yum rnams dang*// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis// sngon tshe thub pa'i spyan snga ru// de yis ji ltar bsgos pa dang*// nyid kyis ji ltar dam bcas dang*// khyod kyi 'khor gyis khyod las ni// ji ltar bsgo ba thob pa yi// dam tshig nye bar dgongs mdzod la// thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bstan la gnod byed gdul ba dang*// bstan pa rjes su sgrub byed pa// thams cad nye bar skyong bar mdzod// bza' ba sna tshogs bca' bar ldan// sran chen sna tshogs 'bras bur bcas// sha chen sna tshogs nya shar bcas// khrag chen zhag dang khrag gzhan bcas// zan dron me tog rnying pa dang*// spos dang chang phud mar me dang*// sna tshogs dar sogs kyis klubs pa'i// gtor ma 'di ni ting 'dzin dang*// sngags kyis rgya cher byin brlabs nas// dwang ba'i sems kyis bdag 'bul gyis// gsol cig gsol cig bza' ba'i tshogs// 'chos shig 'chos shig bca' ba'i tshogs// 'thung shig 'thung shig btung ba'i tshogs// snoms shig snoms shig dri dang spos// bzhes shig bzhes shig mchod pa'i tshogs// tshim par rol nas bdag la dgongs// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// bdag la gnod par byed pa yi// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// mngon spyod las kyi tshar chod la// de yi phun tshogs gang yin pa// de kun bdag gi 'byor bar mdzod// slan chad gnod byed thams cad kyis// glags mi rnyed par srung du gsol// gzhan yang nad dang bar chad kun// shin tu nye bar zhi ba dang*// tshe dang longs spyod dpal 'byor rnams// kun nas rab tu rgyas pa dang*// mi dang mi min ma lus pa// bdag gi dbang du bsdu ba dang*// gzhan yang ji ltar gang 'dod pa// de kun ji bzhin 'grub par mdzod// de ltar dpal gdong bzhi pa la bstod cing bskul ba'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni/

dge slong 'phags pa la de nyid kyi slob ma rig pa'i nor 'chang ba/ ting 'dzin shes rab ces bya bas yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa'i don du/ chu mo bya'i lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la/ shing kun tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
